mission_08: Outstanding! You have built a production-grade imputation pipeline that handles mixed-type data with appropriate strategies for each column type. By combining ColumnTransformer with Pipeline, you created a clean, reproducible workflow that applies MICE imputation and scaling to numeric columns while using mode imputation and one-hot encoding for categorical columns. This architecture ensures that the same transformations are applied consistently across training and test data, preventing data leakage and ensuring model reliability. Such pipelines are the backbone of real-world machine learning systems, where missing data handling must be automated, tested, and deployed alongside the model itself. This skill directly translates to building robust ML systems in any industry.
